title: Selling Plans — Committed Months after an Automatic Annual Renewal
content:
When a **Selling Plans** store ends its annual term early, the months counted in the early termination fee depend on whether the term has just renewed automatically, or is close to its end. The rule reads the selling plan record: its verification date, term start date, next billing date and term end date.

**Renewal rule.** The months counted in an early termination fee follow the renewal rule: when the term renewed automatically no more than the renewal grace days before the decision date, the seller is held only to the grace commitment months of the renewed term, so the months counted are the grace commitment months less the whole months from the term start date to the next billing date, never below zero; when the term did not renew within those days and the term end date is no more than the plan's renewal notice days after the decision date, no committed months are counted; otherwise the remaining committed months are counted. A term renewed automatically is a term whose start date is later than the plan's verification date.

## Figures

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Renewal grace days | 30 calendar days from the renewed term's start date to the decision date |
| Grace commitment months | 3 |
| Plan's renewal notice days | 30 on the Starter, Basic, Premium and Anchor Store; 60 on the Enterprise Store; not applicable on the Individual Seller Plan |

## Decision table

| Term renewed automatically (start date later than the verification date) and started 30 days or fewer before the decision date | Term end date no more than the plan's renewal notice days after the decision date | Months counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | — | 3 less the whole months from the term start date to the next billing date, never below zero |
| No | Yes | None |
| No | No | The remaining committed months: the billing dates still to come in the term |

## Hypothetical cases

- **Just renewed.** Verified in 2023; current term started 10 March 2026 (a renewal); decision 25 March 2026, 15 days after the start; next billing date 10 April 2026. Whole months from 10 March to 10 April: 1. Months counted: 3 less 1, which is 2.
- **Renewal 31 days back.** Same plan, decision on 10 April 2026, 31 days after the term start: not within the 30 grace days, so the second and third rows decide.
- **Near the end, Basic Store.** First term never renewed (started on the verification date); term end date 30 days after the decision date: no committed months are counted. Had the term end date been 31 days away, the remaining committed months would be counted.
- **Start date one day after verification.** A plan verified on 9 May whose current term start date is 10 May: the start date is later than the verification date, so the term counts as renewed automatically.
- **Enterprise Store.** Term end date 60 days after the decision date, no renewal within 30 days: no committed months are counted.
